summary: The blessed identify scroll reaches read.c:seffect_identify, but js/read.js:seffects supports only a narrow ordinary-scroll arm and records this blessed arm as unported. C consumes the scroll before item discovery, chooses an identification count from BUC and RNG, then calls invent.c:identify_pack. Port the complete read.c effect and production spell/scroll wiring so prompts, scroll removal, RNG, and inventory messages follow source order.

source.branch: seffect_identify consumes a scroll before learnscrolltyp, prints the identification message based on Confusion, curse, and prior knowledge, and may return after identifying only itself. Otherwise it selects cval, with blessed or one-in-five uncursed RNG taking a second rn2(5), then calls identify_pack(cval,!already_known) if inventory remains; empty inventory emits a separate message. A spellbook caller skips scroll consumption.
callers: read.c:seffects SCR_IDENTIFY and SPE_IDENTIFY arms dispatch seffect_identify after doread or spell.c:spelleffects; js/read.js:seffects currently covers a narrow ordinary-scroll arm and records note_unported(read.c seffect_identify) for this blessed case and the remaining arms.
dependencies: invent.c:identify_pack has a JavaScript counterpart in js/invent.js with automatic-all and menu selection branches; the C caller discards its result but awaits its messages and inventory state changes.

read.c:learnscrolltyp, useup, and object discovery must run before the inventory prompt as C orders them. Check confusion, cursed-unknown, blessed, and spellbook paths in addition to the selected case.
